title: Damage To Mini
description: Allows the game to become small when taking damage
body:
_Datapack that reduces the player's_ size when taking **damage**.

This modification package adds **complexity** to the gameplay, _increasing its dynamics_ and _requiring the player to plan their actions more carefully_. This helps to increase engagement and interest in the gameplay, and also reduces the degree of ease of completing the game.

# New update 2.0 ▼
The datapack has been updated so that other stats, such as damage, speed, jump power, safe fall blocks, and size, now decrease with a decrease in growth.

Regeneration through food has been removed, and only unnatural types of regeneration (golden apples, regeneration potion, and mysterious dandelion stew) are available, as well as a new method: **vampirism**, which replenishes health by **2.5** hearts when any mob is killed and slows down the player by 5 seconds.

_The author's information has been removed when using /reload._
